cross_merchant_finding.agent_sql:
-- query_lake (Kroger's view; runner CTE-wraps lake_transactions
--                from the tenant tables and excludes KRG's own rows)
SELECT peer_id,
       peer_segment,
       ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2)      AS peer_avg_unit_price,
       COUNT(*)                       AS lines
FROM lake_transactions
WHERE category = 'DAIRY'
  AND txn_date >= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY peer_id, peer_segment
ORDER BY peer_id

sql_basket_comparison:
-- query_lake (Kroger's view)
WITH per_txn AS (
  SELECT lake_txn_id, peer_id, peer_segment,
         SUM(qty) AS items_per_txn
  FROM lake_transactions
  GROUP BY lake_txn_id, peer_id, peer_segment
)
SELECT peer_id, peer_segment,
       ROUND(AVG(items_per_txn), 2) AS avg_basket_size
FROM per_txn
WHERE peer_segment = 'grocery'
GROUP BY peer_id
ORDER BY avg_basket_size DESC;

anomaly_callouts.title: University City decline — KRG / ACM / WDX
anomaly_callouts.headline: Per-grocer foot-traffic decline at University City stores: Kroger 0.63×, Acme 0.71×, Winn-Dixie 0.72× in the Apr 26 – May 2 window vs Mar 1 – Apr 11 baseline.
anomaly_callouts.sql:
SELECT s.merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS txns
FROM tenant_transactions t
JOIN tenant_stores s ON s.store_id = t.store_id
WHERE s.neighborhood = 'University City'
  AND t.txn_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-26' AND '2026-05-02 23:59:59'
GROUP BY s.merchant_id;

anomaly_callouts.title: Plaza Midwood Kroger — avocado quantity spike
anomaly_callouts.headline: Avocado units at Kroger Plaza Midwood peak Apr 22 (5× design multiplier on PRODUCE selection), trailing off through Apr 24.
anomaly_callouts.sql:
SELECT DATE(t.txn_ts) AS day, SUM(i.qty) AS qty
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_stores s       ON s.store_id = t.store_id
JOIN tenant_products p     ON p.sku = i.sku
WHERE s.store_zip5 = '28205' AND t.merchant_id = 'KRG'
  AND p.category = 'PRODUCE' AND p.name LIKE '%vocado%'
GROUP BY DATE(t.txn_ts) ORDER BY day;

anomaly_callouts.title: Pasta promos — coordinated, divergent outcomes
anomaly_callouts.headline: Three grocers ran pasta promos in late April. Kroger's lifted, Winn-Dixie's lifted modestly, Acme's depressed sales during the promo (the planted failure).
anomaly_callouts.sql:
SELECT t.merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS pasta_lines
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p     ON p.sku = i.sku
WHERE p.subcategory = 'pasta'
  AND DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-04-15' AND '2026-04-28'
GROUP BY t.merchant_id;
